name: Shodan Monitor
description: Monitors a list of public IPs with Shodan and posts what changed to a Mattermost channel.

settings_schema.header: Monitors a list of public IP addresses with Shodan and posts what changed. Run /shodan help in Mattermost for all commands.
settings_schema.footer: Reports are posted to the private channel chosen with /shodan report-here. Access: system admins, team admins of the report team (when enabled above), and users added with /shodan access add @user.

settings.help_text: One key per line. When several keys are given, they are used in turn. A key that is invalid or out of credits is skipped for the rest of a run, and the report warns about it.
How often the whole IP list is looked up again and the changes posted to the report channel. Set to 0 to turn scheduled lookups off.

When on, team admins of the team that receives the scheduled reports (see /shodan report-here) can use Shodan Monitor. System admins always have access; other users can be added with /shodan access add.

Upload a .txt file with one IP address per line to replace the whole list. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored; invalid and non-public addresses are rejected. Single IPs can be added or removed with /shodan add and /shodan remove. Users with access who are not system admins can upload by sending the file to @shodan-monitor in a direct message.
